foundWildlife: Found wildlife that may need help?
heroReporter: Record what you see, step by step. Nothing is shared without your say-so — and “Unknown” is always a valid answer.
heroProfessional: Clear information. Safer handoffs. Record what was observed, keep the whole story in order, and pass the case on without losing context.
guideMeBlurb: Guide me walks you through a real report, one friendly step at a time.
noReportsHint: Report wildlife to start recording what you see — observations, photos and handoffs.
noIncidentsHint: Create your first incident to start recording observations and handoffs.
inProgressHint: Someone is helping or the case is being handed over.
awaitingHint: Recorded and waiting for a responder to pick it up.
safetyPeople: Keep people and pets away where possible
safetyProfessional: Contact an appropriate local professional when needed
homeSubtitle: Help with the animal in front of you — calmly and safely.
leaderboardBlurb: A friendly local motivator: your report milestones, plus counts from devices you sync with on the same network. Nothing is ranked globally and nothing leaves the devices involved.
